races.name: EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C & D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Nascent Star
runners_data.note: Expensive Hugo Palmer debutant with strong pedigree but completely unknown quantity over this sharp 5f trip
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to French/Spanish 5.5f-7f winner Fiction; dam, unraced half-sister to winners Azmeel (1m2f Group 3) and Baisse (German 1m Listed), is out of a useful 7f/1m winner; yard's juveniles are going very well so this Starman colt rates an interesting prospect.

runners_data.name: Barnaby Rudge
runners_data.note: Well-bred James Fanshawe newcomer from decent family, Daniel Muscutt booking suggests expectations
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000gns 2yo; Inns Of Court colt; half-brother to 5f winner Miss Yechance (RPR 92); dam, 5f 2yo winner (RPR 82), is a half-sister to US 8.5f stakes winner Fuente Ovejuna, out of a maiden half-sister to French 1m2f Group 1 winner Jemayel; hooded for his debut but in good hands and needs considering.

runners_data.name: Blondie Larry
runners_data.note: Showcasing colt from classy family but Jamie Osborne stable struggling for winners this season
runners_data.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; Showcasing colt; dam, Group-placed 6f winner (RPR 101), is out of an unraced half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Claremont; appeals on paper so he can't be ruled out, especially if the market vibes are positive.

runners_data.name: Dreamlover
runners_data.note: Disappointed as favourite on debut but gelding operation since suggests physical issues addressed
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 13-8 for his debut but looked in need of the experience when fourth of six in 5f Southwell maiden last month; since gelded and this son of Cotai Glory is clearly thought capable of better.

runners_data.name: Wolf's Gallop
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner in field, 26 days since encouraging debut seventh at Doncaster
runners_data.comment: £26,000 yearling, £42,000 breeze-up 2yo; rare juvenile runner for his yard; market useful
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 but hinted at promise with debut seventh of nine in maiden at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) 26 days ago; this son of Sergei Prokofiev can build on it now.

runners_data.name: One In A Millz
runners_data.note: Finished last on debut and warning signs about fading in finish make him hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Bungle Inthejungle March foal; 60,000euros yearling; the biggest price at auction
runners_data.spotlight: 12-1 when last of 12 on his debut in a maiden at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; this son of Bungle Inthejungle needs to take a major step forward.

runners_data.name: Moriarty Moon
runners_data.note: Most experienced runner with two starts, showed greenness at Chester but capable of improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Starspangledbanner colt who still looked green when seventh of 11 in 6f Chester novice 12 days ago; can take another step forward here.

runners_data.name: Shaniko
runners_data.note: Finished last in seller on debut wearing hood, needs significant improvement to feature
runners_data.comment: Only minor appeal on paper and likely best watched on debut; wears a hood
runners_data.spotlight: Hooded for her debut when last of 12 in seller at Chester (6f, good) 12 days ago; significantly more is required.

runners_data.name: Agnes Hathaway
runners_data.note: Still looked inexperienced at Bath but Oscar Performance filly bred to improve with time
runners_data.comment: Green when eighth (Cydney Sweenie third) at Wolverhampton on debut; open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Oscar Performance filly; still looked in need of the experience when seventh of nine in 5.5f Bath maiden 16 days ago; she's the sort to do better in due course.

runners_data.name: Priscilla's Hope
runners_data.note: Consistent without being spectacular, placed once from three starts but needs to find more
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form shown in her three runs thus far, fifth of nine in 6f Redcar maiden 16 days ago; needs to take a step forward.

races.paceDynamic: Wolf's Gallop looks the only confirmed pace-setter with his prominent style, likely to dictate terms unopposed from the front in this novice field. Dreamlover may provide some early company but the overall pace should be steady rather than fierce given the lack of natural speed. The moderate early gallop will suit horses who can stay close enough to strike, while those needing to come from too far back face a difficult task. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wolf's Gallop Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Wolf's Gallop gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The Tom Lacey runner can use his race fitness advantage to kick clear in the final furlong when the newcomers start to tire. His previous seventh at Doncaster showed promise and the step up in trip suits his style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If one of the expensive debutants shows natural ability and settles well
scenarios.body: The pedigrees of Nascent Star, Barnaby Rudge or Blondie Larry suggest significant improvement from their stable debuts, with their price tags reflecting serious expectations. A well-bred newcomer could exploit the modest form standard and win with authority.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Experience Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy affair with inexperienced horses making mistakes
scenarios.body: Moriarty Moon's two previous runs give him a crucial edge in racecraft over the many debutants in the field. His Michael Bell stable is in good form and Paul Mulrennan can time his challenge perfectly when others get into trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Wolf's Gallop sets unsustainably fast fractions or fades dramatically
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace could see a hold-up horse like Agnes Hathaway or Moriarty Moon produce a sweeping finish. However, this requires the leaders to completely capitulate which seems unlikely given the expected moderate tempo.

watchPoints.text: Wolf's Gallop could get a completely uncontested lead if no other early pace materializes, making him very dangerous
Watch for market support for any of the three expensive debutants Nascent Star, Barnaby Rudge or Blondie Larry
Moriarty Moon showed greenness last time but represents the most in-form stable with Michael Bell's recent winners
Early pace could be even slower than expected if Dreamlover doesn't show early speed alongside Wolf's Gallop
Ground conditions remain consistent across the card at Nottingham with all races run on good turf

races.name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Decade Of Time
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with perfect race conditions, 38-day break ideal and carrying weight penalty suggests confidence from Channon yard.
runners_data.spotlight: Study Of Man colt who shaped really well with a debut Newbury third before cosily landing 11-runner novice at Windsor (1m) last month; has to concede weight all round but looks to have more to offer; big player.

runners_data.name: Prince Of Calypso
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity after 280-day absence but cheekpieces and gelding suggest trainer expects improvement from patient McDonald ride.
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped well under a patient ride with a debut third of ten in 7f Haydock maiden in September; since gelded (cheekpieces also added) and this son of Calyx seems sure to take a step forward on his seasonal return.

runners_data.name: Odogwu
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who faded late over 7f last time but this step up to 1m2f should suit his stamina-laden style better.
runners_data.comment: Stable gets plenty of 3yo winners first time out; market useful
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1, made a very encouraging start when fifth of 15 in a novice at Newbury (7f, good) last month, fading only late on; this son of Earthlight is open to a fair bit of progress so needs considering.

runners_data.name: Fractional
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner whose hold-up style needs a strong pace to be effective, but Haggas/Fallon combination excels in tactical scenarios.
runners_data.comment: Needs to leave both pieces of 2yo form (better on debut) well behind her; likely to stay
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped well on both runs as a 2yo, third in 1m Yarmouth maiden in October; found the step up to Listed level too much on her return when fifth of six at Newbury (1m2f), but this daughter of Frankel remains with plenty of potential; cheekpieces added.

races.paceDynamic: Decade Of Time will take this race forward from the gates with his prominent style, likely unopposed early as Prince Of Calypso and the two hold-up horses Odogwu and Fractional will settle behind. With only four runners and no genuine speed merchants, Decade Of Time can dictate a steady gallop throughout the 1m2f journey without pressure. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the modest early pace will allow front-runners to conserve energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Decade Of Time is allowed an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: His class edge and perfect trip positioning allow him to control the race from pillar to post, with the hold-up horses struggling to make up ground from the modest pace. George Bass can dictate terms and kick clear when the challengers come hunting.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Fractional's superior RPR of 101 and Haggas's tactical acumen come to the fore as she sweeps past the moderate gallop-setters. The race becomes a pure speed test over the final 2f where class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prince Calypso Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Of Calypso shows significant improvement from his 280-day break with new headgear
scenarios.body: The gelding operation and cheekpieces transformation allows McDonald to track Decade Of Time before challenging, benefiting from both the steady pace and reduced weight burden. Edward Bethell's patient approach pays dividends with a fresher, sharper horse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If all four runners settle too conservatively creating a crawling pace throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse can win depending on racing room and luck in running. Positioning becomes crucial as horses bunch together turning for home in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Prince Of Calypso's market support given his long absence - any confidence would be significant given his unknown current ability level.
Decade Of Time's early positioning - if he goes too fast early he could set it up for the closers despite the small field.
Fractional's settling pattern - she needs to be closer than usual given the likely modest pace scenario.
Track positioning through the first half-mile as the small field may spread out unusually wide on Nottingham's open track.
The 1m2f start position and how aggressively the jockeys ride early - this will determine if it becomes truly tactical or maintains some tempo.

races.name: Wildwest Beer Festival 4th July Handicap

runners_data.name: Triple Double A
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with highest class but 34 days off and needs the pace to collapse late to show his best
runners_data.comment: Twice held since making a successful return at Newcastle in February; wouldn't want rain
runners_data.spotlight: Reeled off a fast-ground 1m hat-trick last spring; better than ever when landing a 1m2f handicap at Newcastle on his seasonal return in February; no further progress and he drops back to 1m on a recovery mission; today's drop in grade will suit.

runners_data.name: Swift Salian
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in ideal position behind the leader with consistent recent form and versatile going requirements
runners_data.spotlight: Two solid runner-up efforts in 2026 and he won't mind what the weather does; sneaking up the weights but no obvious reason why he wouldn't give it another good go.

runners_data.name: Return To Unit
runners_data.note: Prominent type with strong C&D form and improving trajectory, perfectly placed to track Miletus
runners_data.comment: Well-bred Newmarket challenger who has considerable potential off his opening mark
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each run as a 3yo, getting off the mark in a C&D maiden last October (good ground); couldn't land a blow on his seasonal/handicap debut at Ayr (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, but still has potential and blinkers could help unlock it.

runners_data.name: San Juanito
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 180-day layoff with much to prove on turf after AW success
runners_data.comment: Dual winner for the Crisfords here last spring; not as good since and new headgear tried
runners_data.spotlight: Two AW wins for the Crisfords but much more to prove on turf; absent since a midfield finish on his stable debut in December; enough to prove.

runners_data.name: On The River
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid spring form but disappointed last time at Pontefract over shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Two solid runs this year and fully effective over C&D; drying ground the concern this time
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fifth in the Spring Mile on his return and then found only a stablemate too strong at Ripon in April (both 1m, good to soft); not so good at Pontefract last time when faced with good ground; the more rain to fall the better for him.

runners_data.name: Wondrous Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare showing improved form this year with a recent C&D win and good course knowledge
runners_data.comment: In good form dropped to about 1m this term; still unexposed over this sort of trip
runners_data.spotlight: She has looked an improved performer this year, winning at Beverley on her reappearance (8.5f, good to soft) and adding a C&D fillies' handicap last month (good to soft); up in class and now taking on male opposition but she shouldn't be underestimated.

runners_data.name: One Night Thunder
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose 7f preference makes the 1m½f distance a significant concern
runners_data.comment: Down the field on his Thirsk return but last summer's 7f form brings him right into it
runners_data.spotlight: All wins over 7f, but he did run well over C&D in June 2023 and was staying on at the finish at Haydock (7f, good) last month; significant rainfall would aid his claims.

runners_data.name: Miletus
runners_data.note: Lone front runner who will dictate the pace but has only one career win despite consistent recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Some creditable efforts for new yard this season and he has claims back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win to his name after 14 starts but he has performed with credit in four runs for his new stable, including second-place finishes at Lingfield (1m, AW) and Doncaster (7f good to soft); hood experiment quickly aborted; should go well again.

runners_data.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran whose AW hat-trick form didn't translate to turf last time at this course
runners_data.comment: Five-time turf winner who has rattled off a hat-trick on AW this spring; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Was recording wins eight, nine and ten when rattling off an AW hat-trick this spring (1m-8.6f); the wheels came off when well-beaten over C&D 33 days ago, however, and this mark looks beyond him.

races.paceDynamic: Miletus is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with Swift Salian, Return To Unit and On The River settling prominently behind him. The middle phase will be controlled by Miletus with no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a steady rhythm over the 1m½f trip. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Triple Double A, Wondrous Light, One Night Thunder and Youarenotforgiven will need to rely on the pace quickening late to deliver their finishing kicks. This sustainable early pace strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader without using energy and kick when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Miletus gets an easy lead and the pace stays steady until the final 3f
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk comfortably and have first run on the hold-up horses when the pace quickens. Swift Salian and Return To Unit are perfectly positioned to strike with Return To Unit showing improved form this year.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Miletus goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a searching finish that plays to their strengths. Triple Double A has the class edge while Wondrous Light brings improving form into this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Miletus uses the lack of early pace pressure to build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: Having faced no early pressure, Miletus can sustain his advantage as others struggle to close the gap despite his modest recent form. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Distance Doubt Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the 1m½f trip finds out several runners who prefer shorter distances
scenarios.body: One Night Thunder's 7f preference becomes a major liability while horses proven at this trip gain a significant advantage. Return To Unit's C&D maiden win and Wondrous Light's recent C&D success give them clear edges.

watchPoints.text: Miletus getting too easy a lead early as no other confirmed pace pressers could allow him to steal the race
Triple Double A's 34-day absence affecting his sharpness when he needs to quicken off a steady pace
Return To Unit building on his C&D maiden win with Ray Dawson taking the ride for Roger Varian
One Night Thunder struggling with the step up to 1m½f given his strong 7f preference
Swift Salian maintaining his consistent 2026 form with another solid effort from his prominent position

races.name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Caraway
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won well last time at 1m4f but faces uncontested pace that may not suit his closing style.
runners_data.comment: 0-5 but she ran into lots of trouble when favourite at Wolverhampton latest; dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when winning a Class 5 handicap at Thirsk last month (1m4f, good), travelling strongly but taking a while to pick up before seeing her race out well; up 5lb but she's bred to be smart and this additional distance looks a big plus; strong contender.

runners_data.name: Wedonttellthetruth
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with good form at this trip who could track Sir Griflet and get first run turning for home.
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for the step up to 1m4f, addition of headgear (cheekpieces) and switch to handicaps when a well-backed winner at Wolverhampton in March; similar form when sixth at Kempton three weeks later but latest run (blinkered first time) was disappointing; upped to 1m6f for his turf debut and he needs more for it.

runners_data.name: Gemical
runners_data.note: Hold-up type stepping up in distance with new visor but needs pace collapse to be effective from the rear.
runners_data.comment: 0-5 but showed some improvement latet (1m4f, good); drops 2lb; headgear tried; player.
runners_data.spotlight: Respectable efforts in 1m4f handicaps on her last two runs, the latest at Catterick when tried in a visor for the first time; dropped 3lb and now tackles a longer trip; place claims again.

runners_data.name: Song Of The Stars
runners_data.note: Strong closer who won his turf debut 12 days ago and the trip increase may unlock further improvement.
runners_data.comment: Safely held when third on AW this month and now 0-6; more needed on turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt when making a successful turf debut at Lingfield 12 days ago (extended 1m3f, good to firm); stepping up in trip could unlock further progress and she holds leading claims up 5lb.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner who will control the pace completely and gets ideal tactical setup with no early pressure.
runners_data.comment: Failed to improve on handicap debut when sixth at Windsor 15 days ago; not written of yet
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort to date when a close fourth at Wolverhampton nine days ago (1m4f), headed in the home straight and losing two more places close home; steps up in trip with cheekpieces added; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Femme Fatale
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 64-day break who showed promise as a juvenile but disappointed on handicap debut here.
runners_data.comment: One encouraging 2yo run (1m1f, good to soft); market useful handicapping after a break
runners_data.spotlight: The second of her three runs as a 2yo was respectable; 18-1 and well beaten on her handicap debut here (1m2f, good) nine weeks ago; could leave that behind now stepping up 4f in trip and sporting a hood for the first time.

runners_data.name: Riddikulus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying this distance for first time whose breeding suggests she may improve significantly at 1m6f.
runners_data.comment: Unplaced in six starts and only moderate form; others preferred.
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in her six runs at up to 1m2f; some encouragement for this new trip on breeding and could yet have a bigger effort in her.

runners_data.name: Fairydale
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was third over 1m6f last time but beaten 10 lengths in weak three-runner contest.
runners_data.comment: Unraced beyond 1m2f; usually held up but not sure if this will pan out ideally for her
runners_data.spotlight: Little impact since handicapping and when third at Redcar 16 days ago (first run at the trip) she was still beaten nearly 10l in a three-runner race; headgear dispensed with today; not solid.

races.paceDynamic: Sir Griflet is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set a comfortable tempo with no pace pressure from start to finish. Femme Fatale and Wedonttellthetruth may track him in second and third, but neither has strong early pace to challenge his lead. This sets up a tactical race where Sir Griflet controls the gallop and kicks for home, while the hold-up horses like Caraway, Gemical, Song Of The Stars and Riddikulus must rely on their finishing kick from the back. This pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can sit close to the uncontested pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Griflet maintains his lead without serious pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: He kicks clear turning for home before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. The lack of early pace allows him to save energy for a strong finish that the closers cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even slower than expected in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash devastating finishing kicks. Caraway or Song Of The Stars time their runs perfectly as Sir Griflet weakens in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Wedonttellthetruth or Femme Fatale sit closer than usual to Sir Griflet
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader turning for home and prove too strong. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike before the hold-up horses can get involved.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly in the middle stages creating a stamina test
scenarios.body: The step up in trip becomes crucial and horses with proven staying power benefit. Riddikulus or Fairydale find improvement from the extended distance as others weaken late.

watchPoints.text: Sir Griflet breaking fast and establishing clear early lead - if he gets soft fractions he becomes very dangerous
Song Of The Stars settling well early despite stepping up in trip - his recent turf debut win suggests more improvement
Wedonttellthetruth tracking within striking distance of Sir Griflet through the middle stages - could get ideal tactical position
Caraway's position turning for home - needs to be close enough to mount challenge despite lack of pace pressure ahead
Riddikulus showing any early enthusiasm for the step up to 1m6f - breeding suggests this trip could transform her

races.name: Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: High Opinion
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has needed his recent runs but shows improved form with Mulrennan, though faces traffic concerns with four similar styles
runners_data.comment: 10lb lower (and claimer ridden) than when seeing off Our Absent Friends here in Aug 2024.
runners_data.spotlight: Two C&D wins on soft and good ground; below best in the autumn and has needed both runs in 2026 but he's run two of his best races for Paul Mulrennan (1-3 on him) who is back up today; on a handy mark and a revival could be imminent.

runners_data.name: Toptime
runners_data.note: Front runner with course win and fresh form advantage, perfectly positioned to control this race from the start
runners_data.comment: Curled up late when last in action at Southwell (5f) 217 days ago; is positively drawn.
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner last August (good; has won on soft); has often run well or won following a break and he did so again when involved in a close finish at Thirsk last week on first run since October; weighted to find another race and likely to be involved.

runners_data.name: Thornaby Pearl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form since wind surgery, represents the main threat to the leader from his ideal tracking position
runners_data.comment: Hamilton win in August; mixed form this term; best form on good or softer so needs rain
runners_data.spotlight: Has course form; 6f and 5f wins have come on a variety of tracks and he's won two of his six 5f runs since having wind surgery, most recently at Pontefract (good; acts well on soft) on Monday; unpenalised for that apprentice win under Oliver Carmichael; leading claims.

runners_data.name: Albegone
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with course form but faces traffic problems with three other similar running styles in the field
runners_data.comment: On a dangerous mark but drying conditions wouldn't be in his favour
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple wins, including over C&D; best turf form in 2026 came when involved in a tight finish on this track in April (good; has won on soft) and although some so-so efforts since, a recent Musselburgh second suggested he has a good run in him back here.

runners_data.name: Wrestling Revenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has shown he can make running when needed, carries lowest weight but 14 days since last run
runners_data.comment: On a good mark and latest Ripon 5th was encouraging; one to consider, especially if backed
runners_data.spotlight: Flexible regarding the going; had mixed results since winning at Pontefract (5f, soft) last October, but he wasn't far away after making the running at Ripon recently and is now 2lb lower than that last winning mark; probably needs a bit more.

runners_data.name: Charging Bull
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden wearing headgear for first time, AW specialist making rare turf appearance and appears outclassed
runners_data.comment: Free-going maiden; having a first crack at 0-50 company and he's one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden after ten starts, seemingly best on the AW but he could never get involved on apparently favourable terms in a Wolverhampton classified event recently and has work to do back on turf.

races.paceDynamic: Toptime is the only confirmed front runner in this six-horse field and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With Thornaby Pearl likely to sit prominently but not challenge for the lead, Toptime can control fractions through the early stages. The four hold-up horses (High Opinion, Albegone, Wrestling Revenue, Charging Bull) will be bunched behind, setting up a sprint finish over the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent runners who can avoid the traffic that will inevitably develop when the hold-up quartet converge in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Toptime Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Toptime establishes an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The experienced front runner can kick clear in the final furlong before the hold-up horses get organized, replicating his recent Thirsk performance. His course win and ability to perform fresh gives him the tactical advantage in this setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Thornaby Pearl tracks Toptime into the straight and outkicks him
scenarios.body: The recent Pontefract winner can use his tactical speed from a prominent position to time his challenge perfectly. His wind surgery success and course form make him the biggest threat to the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the four hold-up horses create a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: High Opinion and Albegone have the class to overcome traffic problems if they get clear runs. Their higher ratings could prove decisive if they can navigate the inevitable congestion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Toptime goes too slow early and gets swamped by superior pace
scenarios.body: Wrestling Revenue showed his ability to make running at Ripon and could benefit from a messy finish. The lighter weight and Mullen's tactical nous could exploit a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Toptime breaks slowly from stalls as front runners can struggle if they lose early position in small fields
Traffic developing in final furlong when High Opinion, Albegone, Wrestling Revenue and Charging Bull all converge from hold-up positions
Thornaby Pearl getting too close to Toptime early and forcing unsustainable fractions that could compromise both leaders
Charging Bull's headgear change and surface switch creating unpredictable running behavior
Wrestling Revenue attempting to make running if Toptime doesn't show early speed, changing the entire pace dynamic

races.name: Dine In Sherwoods Restaurant Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: South Shore Island
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to this race shape with no genuine pace pressure and 7-day quick turnaround after promising Wetherby debut
runners_data.comment: 24-race maiden; absent since December but makes stable debut from a workable mark
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed and frustrating maiden for Amanda Perrett but regularly ran well in stronger races than this; promising stable debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) last week, keeping on for a close third; one of the likelier types.

runners_data.name: Rambuso Creek
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage but has class edge with 7lb claimer Whiteley and drops into classified company for first time
runners_data.spotlight: Poor strike-rate for one of his ability; drops into first 0-50 classified event and has good 7lb claimer booked; should give a good account.

runners_data.name: Timebar
runners_data.note: Prominent style gives tactical edge and finished second in this exact race last year on similar good ground
runners_data.comment: 0-15 but was runner-up here in final run last season; needs watching in market on comeback
runners_data.spotlight: 16-race maiden; just touched off in the corresponding event 12 months ago (good ground); absent until returning over 5f here last month, a race where he weakened in the final furlong having raced on his own up the far rail; goes without the blinkers today but still more appealing than many.

runners_data.name: Spirited Dancer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with best recent form after Bath second but faces traffic issues from back of field
runners_data.comment: Won C&D maiden as 2yo; had some disappointments since; now down in grade
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointing since her early-season 2yo days; plummeted down the weights as a consequence and latest Bath second (5.7f, good), her first run at this level, was more encouraging; this looks a deeper race though and she'll need to back it up.

runners_data.name: My Boy Jack
runners_data.comment: All three wins at Wolverhampton over 6f; below his best when last seen and headgear is off
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Posh Maisie
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with concerning fade-in-finish pattern and regressive profile after year off
runners_data.comment: Fair form in her younger days; disappointing recently and best watched after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive 17-race maiden; last of eight on last week's return from a year on the sidelines; best watched.

runners_data.name: Baileys Ontherocks
runners_data.note: Hold-up three-year-old showing no progression with new cheekpieces the only positive angle
runners_data.comment: Down in the weights but she isn't progressing and others have more pressing claims
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 and not progressing, with three runs for Tony Carroll yet to arrest her slide; cheekpieces offer some encouragement for better but others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Yesnia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest form and fade-in-finish concerns, plus 10-day quick turnaround
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; bit more for her new yard in April; could have improvement in her
runners_data.spotlight: Just modest form in her five starts, including in a classified event at Wolverhampton ten days ago; the return to 6f isn't enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: She's A Goldigger
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape but 14-race maiden with too-free tendencies, now has hood fitted
runners_data.comment: 0-13 and best efforts have come on ground on the soft side of good; hard to recommend
runners_data.spotlight: 14-race maiden; too free when fifth of nine at Carlisle (7f, good) a fortnight ago and now drops in trip with a hood fitted; each-way shout if returning to her best.

runners_data.name: Twilight Serenade
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to be placed in eight attempts, dropping to 6f for first time in classified company
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on seasonal debut and has now been unplaced all seven starts
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to be placed after eight attempts; drops back to 6f for his first attempt in classified company but he is not a solid option.

runners_data.name: Charcon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with new cheekpieces after disappointing Carlisle run just three days ago
runners_data.comment: Far from solid on form
runners_data.spotlight: Not a great deal to celebrate in her six runs to date, the latest of them at Carlisle on Monday (6f, soft); new cheekpieces need to spark a surge of improvement.

runners_data.name: Piddie's Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade-in-finish pattern and poor recent form, needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in all five runs and she needs a transformation after 236 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in her six starts, the latest over 7f at Doncaster last week; improvement essential.

runners_data.name: Green Valentine
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fade-in-finish concerns despite past handicap wins at higher level for previous trainer
runners_data.comment: A dual 6f scorer in 2025 for Alan Brown but yet to fire this term; lots more required
runners_data.spotlight: Won 6f handicaps at Hamilton (soft; 25-1) and Newcastle (AW; 66-1) for Alan Brown in the latter part of 2025; short of that level in two runs for new stable; cheekpieces return having been left off over 7f last week.

races.paceDynamic: South Shore Island will set the early gallop with minimal pressure from just Timebar and She's A Goldigger showing any prominent tendencies. The majority of the field - Rambuso Creek, Spirited Dancer, Baileys Ontherocks, Yesnia, Twilight Serenade, Charcon, Piddie's Pearl and Green Valentine - are hold-up horses who will be anchored at the back. This creates a lopsided pace where South Shore Island can dictate fractions unchallenged before the cavalry charge arrives late. The race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can steal crucial lengths while the hold-up brigade sort themselves out in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If South Shore Island gets soft fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front-runner can kick for home with energy reserves intact while the packed field of hold-up horses struggle for racing room in the straight. Prominent racers like Timebar get first run on the leader while the rest are still organizing their challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and South Shore Island stops
scenarios.body: The better-rated closers like Rambuso Creek and Spirited Dancer produce telling late kicks to reel in a tiring leader. Their class advantage tells in the final furlong despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If South Shore Island goes too fast early trying to clear the field
scenarios.body: The leader burns out quickly leaving a messy sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial. The best-positioned hold-up horses with recent form can capitalize on the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up majority get badly hampered in running
scenarios.body: Poor draws and congestion leave several fancied runners with impossible tasks while those who get clear runs benefit disproportionately. Any horse getting an unimpeded passage can take advantage.

watchPoints.text: South Shore Island could steal this if allowed uncontested lead with majority of field anchored at back
Traffic problems virtually guaranteed with nine hold-up horses likely bunched together turning for home
Rambuso Creek has class but worst possible running style for this race composition
Spirited Dancer has best recent form but must overcome tactical disadvantage of hold-up style
Quick turnarounds for South Shore Island (7 days) and Charcon (3 days) could impact stamina reserves
